notes: Every branch marked verified:true had its page actually fetched and read during research. Addresses are copied verbatim from official/authoritative pages. Where only a network-level presence could be confirmed (no specific centre page opened), the city is listed under citiesUnverified. Kvantorium has two sub-variants: standalone regional 'детский технопарк Кванториум' (flagship centres, captured here) and school-based 'Школьный Кванториум' (created at individual schools); for Kazan only school-based Kvantorium sites exist among the target cities, noted in the branch. The federal city of Москва runs its own municipal 'Детские технопарки Москвы' network (technopark-kids.ru) which includes a Кванториум, and is NOT part of the regional-operator federal Kvantorium scheme in the same way; it is captured as a separate network. Москва is also NOT a separate entry in the federal Sirius regional-centres registry.

networks.name: Мобильный технопарк «Кванториум»

Подтверждено существование мобильных площадок в Новосибирской и Нижегородской областях (на официальных сайтах региональных Кванториумов), но конкретных городских адресов в целевых 14 городах нет.
